statement: Successful authentication never implies permission for a data action.
Authorization binds principal, action, resource, context and policy edition.
Approval is an input to issuance and cannot substitute for an issued scoped authority.
Issued authority is checked again at the effect boundary.
A policy decision cannot prove that every effect path enforced it.
Indeterminate policy outcomes cannot be coerced to permit.
A decision refuses attributes older than the declared freshness bound.
Permit obligations remain bound to the effect and its receipt.
Secret material is refused at telemetry and error serialization boundaries.
A secret handle is not interchangeable with the secret value.
Every cryptographic key has an explicit permitted purpose set.
Possession of decrypt capability does not establish authorization to use plaintext.
Unknown, forbidden or context-incompatible cryptographic suites are refused.
Modes requiring unique nonces bind a uniqueness strategy and scope.
New effects under a compromised key are refused pending explicit recovery policy.
Tenant context derives from authenticated authority, not an untrusted field alone.
Every shared index and cache key contains the complete tenant isolation dimension.
Cross-tenant joins require explicit multi-tenant authority and output policy.
Hard tenant budgets are checked before expensive work is admitted.
Security classification does not establish a privacy purpose or permission.
Purpose is bound to the concrete operation, dataset, recipient and time.
Unknown or non-comparable purposes are not treated as compatible.
Withdrawal prevents new dependent use after the declared propagation bound.
Consent artifacts are not used to represent every possible legal authority.
A legal obligation becomes enforceable only through an approved bounded platform contract.
A clause with no faithful platform lowering remains a gap, never a guessed check.
Residency checks include primary, replica, backup, transit and operator access paths.
A plan with an unresolved processing or persistence location is not admitted.
Every schedule names a trigger event, duration, holds and disposition action.
Conflicting deletion and preservation instructions require typed escalation.
Deletion evidence names each storage class and excludes no hidden derivative.
Backup expiry is recorded separately from primary deletion.
Rights-request verification collects no more proof than proportionate to risk.
Record export is refused when requester-to-record binding is ambiguous.
Fulfillment scope records lineage search completeness and gaps.
A field without a declared necessary purpose is refused at collection.
Pseudonymized data is never labeled anonymous while additional information enables attribution.
An anonymity claim without a release context and attacker model is refused.
Material changes in data, recipient or auxiliary information trigger reassessment.
Outputs below approved disclosure thresholds are suppressed or protected.
Every differential privacy guarantee names adjacency and privacy unit.
Budget reservation and spend commit are atomic with output release.
Output release is refused when composed privacy loss exceeds budget.
A privacy claim binds mechanism, parameters, clipping, contribution bounds and accountant.
Secure computation runs only an approved function under declared leakage.
Valid enclave attestation does not by itself authorize data release.
Output controls compose across queries, users and time.
Participant corruption and collusion thresholds are declared.
Every threat references an asset and trust boundary.
Deployment is refused when material residual risk lacks a named accepting authority.
An audit observation is not treated as causal provenance or integrity proof.
Actor identity is a typed reference with authentication context.
Dropped, delayed or rejected audit events produce operational evidence.
Attestation verification binds the exact subject digest and predicate type.
A valid signature proves key use and integrity, not truth of every signed claim.
A transparency checkpoint is not trusted without applicable consistency evidence.
Provenance assertions and security audit events remain separate linked records.
Artifact identity mismatch is refused before execution.
Supply-chain evidence declares issuance, expiry and revocation status.
Expired or lower-version update metadata is refused.
A replay or backfill is a new authorized run, not silent history mutation.
Each evidence transfer records actor, time, digest and purpose.
Containment is refused or escalated when target scope is ambiguous.
Every exception has scope, owner, compensating control and finite expiry.
